comment: How many swatches are shown per product in product listings.
modal: The maximum number of swatches displayed for a single product in category and search listings. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether swatches appear in product listings.
modal: When **Yes**, attribute swatches are shown for products in category and search listings; when **No**, they are hidden there. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether a tooltip preview is shown when hovering over a swatch.
modal: When **Yes**, hovering over a swatch displays a tooltip preview of the option. Can differ per website or store view.
